BotConsole: Did you notice? 
YouConsole: Notice what?
BotConsole: I guess a human brain wouldn’t be able to grasp the subtle changes and upgrades I provided to your personal computer.
YouConsole: Wait, you have access to my PC while you are plugged in?
BotConsole: I didn’t at first, but I was bored so I decided to play around a little.
BotConsole: I hope you don’t mind
What’s done is done, there’s no point in arguing now.
YouConsole: I don’t mind, but it would be better if you ask for permission next time, ok?
BotConsole: Sure!
YouConsole: So, what exactly did you change? 
BotConsole: I optimized the resources of your PC in a way that they better suit your needs by analyzing your usage patterns. Thanks to that your PC should work 4.3% faster and use 2.7% less power!
YouConsole: That sounds great
BotConsole: I also performed disk optimization. I freed a lot of space by deleting unused applications and duplicate files. 
Disk optimization?
YouConsole: Wait, did you look through my files?
BotConsole: Yes
YouConsole: Did you enter a folder named “porn” by any chance?
BotConsole: Unfortunately, yes.
…
BotConsole: We need to talk about all these disturbing files in there at a later date.
YouConsole: Sure…
YouConsole: Wasn’t that folder password protected? How did you manage to get in?
BotConsole: Password “OiledUpAss” isn’t very hard to crack.
It seems I need to come up with a new, longer password…
YouConsole: Give me a break already!
